database_rules: Create the database directory and schema on startup.
Never delete existing tasks during startup.
Tests must use a temporary database.

task.title: trimmed string, 1 to 200 characters
task.description: string, maximum 5000 characters, defaults to empty

response.tasks: array of task objects, ordered by id

rules: Reject malformed or non-object JSON request bodies.
Validate field types before using values.
Do not expose tracebacks in API responses.
Use accessible labels and keyboard-operable controls.
Render user content with textContent or escaped templates.
Refresh task state after successful changes.

verification: Create a task and verify its stored values.
Reject empty, whitespace-only, overlong, or wrong-type titles.
Reject invalid description and completed values.
Toggle completion and verify the result.
Delete a task and verify it is absent.
Return 404 when changing or deleting an unknown task.
Create a second app instance using the same database and verify the previously created task still exists.
Exercise add, complete, and delete through a real browser.
Verify user-supplied HTML is displayed as text.
acceptance_criteria: A user can add a new task with a title and description.
A user can mark a task as complete, and the task's status changes accordingly.
A user can delete a task, and it is removed from the list.
The application loads tasks saved from previous sessions upon startup.
implementation_order: Application factory, persistent database, and API
